narrative_purpose: The cover states the chapter's central image at a glance: an entire village standing on a living reef, the built world of the Na'vi resting on ground that other organisms grew.
subject: A Metkayina reef settlement at dawn: a cluster of woven bulbous pod-dwellings suspended from the thick aerial stilt-roots of giant salt-tolerant mangrove-like trees, elevated wooden walkways linking them above a calm turquoise lagoon. In the mid-distance a low stepped terraced reef barrier, like the rimstone lips of a hot spring, rings the settlement and breaks a line of ocean swell into white foam. Beneath the clear shallow water, branching coral-like growths and encrusting life are faintly visible as the solid floor everything rests on. A few slender blue Na'vi figures move along the walkways and one rides a sleek plesiosaur-like ilu through the shallows.
scene: A sheltered tropical Pandoran lagoon enclosed by a reef atoll, open ocean beyond the barrier fading into layered teal haze, early low sun.
camera: Wide establishing three-quarter aerial view from a moderate height, taking in the village, the lagoon floor and the encircling barrier in one sweep.
light: Cool dawn ambience with soft teal shafts through the water; faint cyan and living-teal bioluminescence along the submerged reef life; one restrained warm amber glow from within a dwelling.
palette: Ocean teal and void indigo dominate, cyan living light along the reef, sparse ember-amber interior accent.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist establishing plate, observed rather than cinematic.
detail_level: Crisp on the nearest pods, roots and reef-crest foam; lagoon floor and distant ocean dissolve into haze.
composition: Village and its tree-roots anchor the foreground left, lagoon opens to centre, the stepped barrier arcs across the background with generous hazy negative space above.
consistency_notes: The dwellings are woven organic pods hung from living mangrove-like roots, not huts on poles. The reef barrier is stepped and terraced. Water is shallow and clear over a visibly living floor.
